findings: Buys: over the five trading days from the fill, the stocks it bought beat SPY by 0.40% on average (42 buys, 55% of them ahead of SPY; t = 0.5, within noise).
Sells: over the five trading days from the fill, the stocks it sold lagged SPY by 0.21%, so selling avoided that (96 sells; t = 0.4, within noise).
Decision IC: on the 27 days it traded, what it bought ranked against what it sold and left alone by a mean rank IC of 0.018 with the next five days' returns (IC IR 0.10, t = 0.5, within noise).
Holdings IC: the weights it held after each of 43 decision days had a mean rank IC of 0.002 with the next five days' returns (t = 0.1, within noise).
Factor exposures: market 0.30 (t 6.5), size -0.08 (t -1.9), growth 0.23 (t 2.9), momentum -0.01 (t -0.4); together they explain 60% of the daily variation (R²).
Of its +6.1% a year over T-bills (arithmetic mean): market +6.4%, growth +5.2%, size -0.4%, momentum -0.3%; the alpha left is -4.9% a year (t = -0.5, within noise).
Verdict: most of the return is factor exposure (+10.9% a year, market above all); the alpha left is not significant.
P&L: +$5,702 in all, +$5,565 from 31 positions and +$137 of interest on idle cash.
By holding period: 61+ days made the most (+$12,772, 10 positions); 6-10 days lost the most (-$2,926, 4 positions).
By sector: Technology made the most (+$6,595, 7 positions); Utilities lost the most (-$2,887, 1 position).
By stock: QCOM made the most (+$2,894, 1 position); NEE lost the most (-$2,887, 1 position).
By market regime of the previous close: risk-on 26 days +1.4% (SPY -4.3%); uncertain 142 days +8.3% (SPY +14.2%); risk-off 85 days -3.7% (SPY +7.2%).
News: 10 positions opened on news made +$5,117, the other 21 +$448; 7 positions closed on news made -$1,087; over the five days from the fill, news-triggered buys beat SPY by 0.44% (t 0.3).

Concentration: the gains are spread out (the best two positions made 36% of them) but winners and losers nearly cancel, so the best two made 98% of the net P&L; the best was QCOM bought 2020-07-17 and still open at the end, +$2,894. Had the best position made nothing, the run would have returned +2.8% instead of +5.7%.
